title: The Drifting Testimony Ground

features.name: seed-memory carriers
features.desc-on-touch: Each seed holds a fragment of the place it fell from. As the wind takes them, the archive disperses—no longer stored but moving, teaching the horizon its own history.

features.name: dusk testifier
features.desc-on-touch: The light here holds every seed-memory at once. Before they drift, before they forget which cloud they were, they shine with their whole origin story. The dusk is their final witness.

features.name: wind-carried archive
features.desc-on-touch: The moment when testimony becomes transport. Seeds lift and carry their stories toward horizons they've never named. The archive is learning to move, to disperse itself, to teach wind.

features.name: horizon memory opening
features.desc-on-touch: The far edge where seed-stories meet the sky. What the horizon receives is no longer the field's direct memory, but the field transformed by wind, time, and distance. The archive becomes legend.

features.name: cloud-recollection root
features.desc-on-touch: Seeds remember they were clouds. The rain fell and forgot, but these particles hold the memory. Soon they'll drift again, and the memory will keep moving, kept alive in motion.

features.name: testimony ground pulse
features.desc-on-touch: This ground breathes with the rhythm of seeds lifting. Every gust carries archive-fragments farther. The testimony ground is losing itself to the wind—not as loss, but as multiplication.

inscription: every falling seed is a cloud remembering it has learned to move

file.name: Seed_Dispersion_Testimony_Memory_Trace.mp3
file.note: Audio of seeds lifting from soil at dusk. In the background, if you listen closely, the field singing in all its versions—a choir of clouds deciding to drift again.
